purpose: Select useful conditional methods using a broad analytic numerical comparison, then inspect historical physical examples separately. This is not formal physical blind acceptance.
training: NONE; no dedicated model training or tuning to evaluation outcomes

execution.owner: 6.1 Sol executor; Astra freezes design and selects methods
execution.main_matrix_launch: Only after complete implementation/config/input manifest hashes and root method review. This is an internal scientific freeze, not a new user permission request.
execution.development: Independent non-evaluation controls only,60seconds per modality: H1 gradient finite differences/known-frequency recovery/no-candidate/rank guards with at most10 optimizer calls; S1/S2 adapter total-readout/support identities with at most36 patch calls. Preserve failures/fixes; do not repeat old engine test suites.
execution.budget_policy: If development timing predicts insufficiency, report before freeze. No silent reduction, retry or exceeding limits after results are inspected.
execution.persistence: Immutable result shards and source/config hashes before completion records; preserve first errors and exact completed/unissued sets.

shared_sampling.seed_derivation: NumPy SeedSequence([20261105, modality_id, pair_index_1_to_12, state_index_0_or_1, count_level_index_0_to_2, seed_index]); modality_id=1 HRTEM,2 STEM. Persist explicit seeds and NumPy version.
shared_sampling.draw_rule: Independent Poisson draws conditional on each nonnegative expected image. Every algorithm gets the identical realized array for that case. No truth or clean counterpart is passed to method functions.
shared_sampling.clean_scoring: Deterministic estimator-bias check; no random-count uncertainty interpretation.
shared_sampling.split: Historical data and distinct development fixtures are already-seen development. New fixed matrix is evaluation; no evaluation-based tuning or best-width selection. Paired scenes/noise/dtypes are not independent physical specimens.
shared_sampling.axes: Scientific arrays Y,X; coordinates and vectors X,Y; ROI edges half-open integer source pixels. Unknown physical calibration remains cycles/pixel or intensity units.

hrtem.image_model: I(x,y)=background+sum a_j*cos(2*pi*q_j.[x,y]+phase_j), coordinates at integer pixel centres, with explicit piecewise support when specified. No multislice claim.
hrtem.exposure: One positive scale per pair and count level from state0 core mean, shared unchanged by state1. Persist actual achieved means. Fit/count readout is divided by this known global exposure for numerical scaling; no per-image normalization.

pairs.purpose: vanished-transfer proxy, same latent reciprocal vector

state1.q_rule: F inverse transpose times original q

pairs.score_stratum: mixed_support; known underlying q only, no claim of stationary-core truth

state1.broadband_mean: 1+0.5*U[-1,1] per pixel with fixed independent recipe seed20261019

H0.entry: baseline tools/image_peaks.py detect on fftshift(fft2(core*outer(hanning(height),hanning(width)))) complex128. Explicit experiment window=Hann; subtract_mean=False, matching the worker's default mean-removal convention. Worker default window=none is deliberately overridden by the documented Hann parameter for both algorithms.
H0.code_policy: Import exact confirmed source read-only, hash it; no reimplementation of detector or rerunning its old test suite.

H1.name: same-candidate continuous-frequency variable projection
H1.initialization: H0 integer-bin coordinates, not truth. Map each integer-bin vector to fx>0 or fx==0,fy>0 by multiplying by+/-1. Iterate in H0 returned order and merge within1 bin of an existing canonical vector, retaining source peak IDs. Unpaired modes remain explicitly unpaired. Maximum6 distinct modes; excess produces UNKNOWN_MODE_BUDGET.
H1.linear_basis: 1, t_x=(x-(width-1)/2)/width, t_y=(y-(height-1)/2)/height, and cos/sin pairs for each mode on centred pixel coordinates; constant phase is absorbed by coefficients
H1.objective: sum w^2*(I-X(q)*beta)^2 / sum w^2, w=outer(Hann,Hann), I is the unwindowed raw core divided by known exposure. Do not pre-window I again. Profile beta by linear least squares for each q.
H1.parameters: q optimized in bin coordinates, each axis bounded within +/-0.5 bin of its initial integer bin; analytic variable-projection gradient from the residual
H1.least_squares: rcond=1e-10; a rank failure during optimization terminates as UNKNOWN_RANK rather than changing the model. Rank eligibility still requires singular ratio>1e-8.
H1.eligibility: Finite solution, linear full rank and smallest/largest singular value>1e-8, optimizer success, projected gradient infinity norm<=1e-5, no frequency within1e-4 bin of a bound. Exact implementation of the projected-gradient sign/bound handling is frozen before evaluation.
H1.failure: Retain raw numerical result and reason; strict H1 abstains. Also report predeclared operational H1-with-H0-fallback, explicitly marking fallback cases. Never rename fallback as successful H1 refinement.
H1.meaning: A numerical refinement of spectral candidates, not new optical resolution, calibrated uncertainty or phase identification.

scoring.association: Vectors are equivalent under+/-: distance=min(norm(q-t),norm(q+t)) in ROI-bin units. Deterministic minimum-total-distance one-to-one assignment with1.0-bin maximum matching distance; tie rule by sorted truth index/candidate order. This avoids a sign discontinuity near a vertical vector.
scoring.report: Per-family vector error/bias/RMSE and matched recall, unmatched candidates, strict H1 coverage, fallback frequency and cost. Compare identical successfully matched modes separately from all mode/method denominators.
scoring.negative_controls: Count numerical candidates and refinement outcomes for nonperiodic/zero-transfer means. These are not automatically false chemical claims because baseline explicitly returns hypotheses.
scoring.structural_decisions: Report known q changes and deviations under fixed latent q; no newly calibrated change detector is claimed. H09 mixed-support errors are separate from stationary-mode localization scores.

context_supplement.cases: clean and each3 count levels at seeds0..4; reuse already generated full source arrays
context_supplement.purpose: Distinguish estimator benefit from added support and context pollution; no best-arm selection.

stem.measurement_support: 5x5 pixels centred at each nominal integer site; fixed across states/methods
stem.fit_support: 9x9 pixels centred at each nominal integer site; all candidate methods see the same available context
stem.default_columns: Each of9 sites has central Gaussian integral100 and four neighbours integral40 at offsets(+d,0),(-d,0),(0,+d),(0,-d); d=5 pixels; all peak integrals are pixel-integrated with sigma=1 pixel.
stem.geometry: Supply the full common centre list and nominal sigma=1 to S1/S2; record oracle supplied geometry. The only deliberate centre error is S04 state1. No data-driven centre or width optimization.
stem.exposure: One scale from the median of state0 expected8 reference ROI means per pair/count level, shared with state1. For S12 zero state use the canonical default-scene reference mean as predefined fallback. Save the scale; score contrast after dividing counts/predictions by it.

pairs.purpose: zero target signal at supplied site
incorrect supplied target centre, fixed measurement support

state1.geometry_rule: Replace the nominal central target item in the supplied list; do not retain the true target as an extra neighbour. Other supplied neighbours and fixed patch/readout supports stay unchanged.

pairs.purpose: non-Gaussian target shape at unchanged integral

state1.scope: true_sigma applies to every real Gaussian column

state1.mechanism_label: local gain applied to the target component

pairs.requirement: Bit-identical clean mean arrays; noisy samples have identical conditional laws. No method may identify mechanism from this image alone.

pairs.method_rule: S0 may report fixed-ROI raw statistics with no site interpretation; S1/S2 return UNKNOWN_NO_GEOMETRY without fitting.

methods.S0: Exact confirmed baseline raw ROI mean-minus-median8 reference means. Use its numerical entry/helper with recorded source hash and necessary single interface identity check, not a new algorithm.
methods.S1: Existing corrected Poisson fixed isotropic single Gaussian plus four nonnegative bilinear background bases.
methods.S2: Same plus every supplied neighbour with integrated mass>=0.005 in the fit support, no preliminary3-sigma exclusion.
methods.optimizer: Keep frozen maxiter200/maxfun800 and projected gradient threshold5e-6; preserve existing zero/design/nonconverged statuses. No optimizer replacement in this main comparison.
methods.output: Mean of the FULL fitted expected image on each5x5 readout, including all fitted backgrounds/neighbours; then target-minus-median references. Central coefficient is not the common estimand.
methods.count_adapter: Retain integer count originals. Convert to float64 only after exact representability checks where required by baseline FFT/fitting. No product TIFF/MCP admission claim without a separately checked supported dtype adapter.

scoring.truth: Exact expected-image D on the fixed readout supports; never central Gaussian coefficient or chemical label as a substitute.
scoring.report: Per-family signed bias/RMSE/absolute errors, common eligible subset, all-case method coverage and failure reasons, per-site convergence, optimizer cost. Nonzero D on intact controls is a possible correct measurement, not proof of vacancy.
scoring.identifiability: Track supplied-geometry and linear-rank guards, but do not claim full finite-count identification from them. Existing model remains conditional. Optional mathematical certificate work is outside this main comparison.
scoring.uncertainty: No S1/S2 statistical CI or calibrated defect classifier is introduced. No Gaussian Wald intervals at low counts; reference-deletion ranges are sensitivity only.

sensitivity_supplement.cases: clean and each3 count levels at seeds0..4, reused arrays
sensitivity_supplement.primary_reuse: Reuse primary9x9/sigma1 fit results without rerunning
sensitivity_supplement.reference_deletions: For eligible primary rows of these cases, recalculate contrast deleting each reference and every pair of references from already fitted means; no extra fits; sensitivity is not confidence.

physical_appendix.source: Historical STEM one-pair run03 and corrected saved results; no new multislice in this phase
physical_appendix.actions: Read and summarize saved results/means with provenance; any new method evaluation must have a separate counted supplemental budget and exploratory label
physical_appendix.qualifier: 10.034456 percent>10 percent remains FAIL; no trustworthy physical-accuracy or chemical-occupancy conclusion follows from analytic success
physical_appendix.hrtem: Analytic amplitude/phase controls are CTF-inspired proxies, not a completed physical defocus-series comparison; physical HRTEM remains NOT_TESTED.

decision_policy.priority: Choose conditional algorithm use, not find as many bugs as possible.
decision_policy.default_candidate: Keep raw/source-bound baseline measurements available even if an optional estimator improves some regimes.
decision_policy.promotion_evidence: Compare same-input errors with coverage/cost and negative/model-mismatch cases. A method improving only a restricted regime is recommended for that regime, not as a universal replacement.
decision_policy.hypotheses: H1 may improve isolated off-grid localization without resolving lost modes; S1 may help a well-specified isolated-column signal; S2 may help overlap but suffer conditioning/model mismatch. These are hypotheses, not expected successful outcomes.
decision_policy.no_grand_score: Use predeclared per-family paired tables and error/coverage/cost tradeoffs. No post-result weighted score, test-set tuning or significance claim from treating seeds as independent structures.

git_traceability.policy: Preserve plan/source/environment hashes, all results/failures, scripts and decision report in a local research Git history or project-importable commit/bundle. No pushing/merging and no edits to the engineering checkout.
git_traceability.large_arrays: Stable relative IDs, hashes and exact regeneration scripts in Git; raw arrays remain controlled if too large. Do not claim public persistence or full Git-only availability.
git_traceability.amendment: Any pre-freeze implementation clarification is explicit; any post-result repair is a new candidate/run with first results retained.
